'''Cameron''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
[[File:Cameron.png|thumb|left|200px|Cameron's corpse examined by Commander Bly]]
Cameron boarded [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] cruiser with Rex, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and a small squad of clones during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] and narrowly survived thanks to Skywalker. However, they would die later at the hands of a [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|mastiff phalone]] on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] while trying to find the natives to heal General Skywalker. They were then thrown on top of [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] by the mastiff phalone, though, even with their [[Death/Legends|death]] they succeeded in helping save Skywalker's life.
